consequence.statement: ScrapeConfig resources with spec.ovhcloudSDConfigs[].service set to an empty string will be rejected by the API server validation.

original.statement: In the ScrapeConfig v1alpha1 CRD, the enum values for spec.ovhcloudSDConfigs[].service changed: the empty string value was removed and replaced with "DedicatedServer" and "VPS".

decision.reason: The proposed consequence comes from a misreading. The computed diff for spec.ovhcloudSDConfigs[].service says "removed [], added [\"DedicatedServer\", \"VPS\"]", so no empty-string value was removed and nothing says empty strings are now rejected. The schema excerpts [ev-db02f66824cd] and [ev-e33dbbb0c01a] are empty, and the crd validator reports the enum as unchanged (inconclusive). The evidence therefore cannot show whether this enum is new (stricter: other values are rejected) or an existing enum that gained values (looser: nothing is rejected). Calling it resource-rejected at high severity would claim mandatory work the evidence doesn't support, and no correct consequence can be worked out without the field's schema from both releases.
